messages:
maya_cs: FYI I'm assembling a short customer-facing runbook we can hand to enablement for go-live. Goal: one-pager for the "orchestra" pattern that stitches cache + batching + streaming so CS teams can reduce cold-start risk and spot renewal signals. Thoughts?

owen_se: love it. keep it very prescriptive — toggles to set, telemetry to watch, and exactly what to tell customers to expect. short bullet steps. :100: 

rachel_csm: Can we include specific renewal-risk heuristics tied to traffic/latency? e.g., sudden drop in session starts or >10% CTA failure rate in first 72h -> outreach. Also a short checklist for handoff with AMs.

sam_sre: +1. From infra side: share a minimal "orchestrator" config snippet they can paste into onboarding guides. Also indicate safe batch_size defaults per model tier and a circuit-breaker example.

maya_cs: Draft snippet I put together — feel free to edit. Marked defaults are conservative for hosted tier.

maya_cs: ```yaml
orchestrator: 
  prefix_cache_ttl: 900          # 15m conservative for onboarding bursts
  kv_cache_enabled: true
  batch: 
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 16          # start conservative; scale with Dedicated
    max_latency_ms: 120         # soft SLO for batching before flush
  streaming: 
    enabled: true
    min_stream_tokens: 8        # stream after X tokens to reduce perceived latency
  circuit_breaker: 
    error_threshold: 0.12       # fraction of errors to open CB
    cool_down_s: 300
```

owen_se: Nice. Add an optional prefill step for customers with known heavy templates (e.g., daily digest generators) — run a small warmup job to populate KV prefix cache 24-72h before launch.

rachel_csm: For the CS one-pager: handoff checklist items I want:
- confirm model + quantization profile (so SRE knows memory)
- expected session RPM during pilot
- 3 sample prompts for eval set (maps to quality monitoring)
- contact for immediate rollback (oncall + AM)
- renewal-risk thresholds (adoption drop, SLA misses)

sam_sre: And telemetry to monitor from day0:
- token/second and tail latency p95
- cache hit rate (prefix + KV) — target >70% after warmup
- batch size distribution (median, 95th pct)
- streaming fallback rate (how often we revert to non-streaming)
- error rate by route/model

maya_cs: Short operator script suggestion for enablement to trigger warmup (run once):

maya_cs: ```bash
# simple warmup: hit common prompts to populate KV/prefix cache
for p in \"prompt1\" \"prompt2\" \"prompt3\"; do
  curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" \\n    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n    -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-small-rl\",\"input\":\"'\$p'\",\"prefill\":true}' &
done
wait
```

rachel_csm: Love the script. Also include a short customer-facing paragraph: what to expect during the warmup window, and when we recommend handing over to AMs for usage coaching. Keep it non-technical.

maya_cs: Draft para: "During warmup (typically 24–72 hours), transient higher latency and token costs are possible while caches populate. We run lightweight, targeted requests to create warm pools for your most common prompts — this reduces latency after the warmup completes. Your CSM will coordinate cadence and monitor early adoption; if you see persistent latency or adoption drops, flag us and we'll roll back aggressive batch/prefill settings while we investigate."

owen_se: Suggest adding a short troubleshooting triage flow: one-liner checks like "is cache hit rate <40%? -> check prefix keys; is p95 latency >750ms? -> reduce max_batch_size or disable prefill jobs".

sam_sre: I'll add a paste-ready SRE contact block (oncall + escalation) and a short runbook for circuit-breaker resets.

rachel_csm: Can we capture feedback in one place? propose a short form link included in all enablement emails: "Launch feedback: did warmup match expectations? issues?" -> auto-tags renewal-risk if critical responses.

maya_cs: Good. I'll assemble final one-pager and short slack-ready summary for AMs. Targeting to push to the enablement repo by EOD tomorrow. cc @deploy-bot for a quick note when it's merged. :wave:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: create PR for "orchestrator-enablement-onepager" at 2024-02-15T16:00:00Z.

maya_cs: Thanks everyone — will post the PR link here when ready and ping the AM rotation list.

owen_se: Thanks, super pragmatic. Happy to pair on the telemetry column tomorrow.

rachel_csm: Thanks — this will make handoffs much smoother. :sparkles:
